title: Luc Montagnier on electromagnetic information transfer in DNA

tellings.quote: and you had this guy Luke Monier who's this French Nobel Prize winner at the end of his life if he was saying you know electromagnetism is really important for communication information transfer within DNA

plain: Near the end of his life, the French Nobel Prize winner Luc Montagnier said that electromagnetism plays an important part in how information is carried and passed along within DNA. Michels brings this up himself, without naming a source, in a conversation about synchronicities and prophetic dreams.
